name: Straw / hay
notes: Straw, hay, thatch and bedding: hay carts, bales, stable floors, roofs. Very flammable (200 °C) and flares out fast (20 s). Density 100 kg/m³ (baled straw). Absorbs falls (0.8, bead note) and sound (0.7). A pile hides whoever is in it (opaque, hideable), as the Briar Glen hay carts need. Soft underfoot (−4 dB). Burns away completely (mw-e03.5). Soft surface: arrows stick in it, but a loose bale cannot hold a rope arrow's load. (mw-e03.31) Straw and hay are hollow stems that wick water up to near saturation (0.9) (mw-e03.59).
